title: Step 59-F Home states accessibility and responsive hardening
description: Close the Home state-presentation gap on top of the existing Step-58 async-state foundation. Map the authoritative Home GET /products AsyncSurfaceState to accessible Home-specific loading, empty, recovery, error, forbidden and offline presentations without changing backend authority or auto-retrying. Preserve previous authoritative product data when a state explicitly carries previous data, expose request identifiers with bidi-safe StatePanel semantics, keep retry as an explicit user action only when bounded and safe, provide a stable alternative search entry without implementing Step 60, and harden Home cards/state actions for long Persian text, RTL logical layout, touch targets and 400% reflow. Do not modify the shared StatePanel foundation, backend/API/OpenAPI/database, downstream routes or business rules.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every non-ready AsyncSurfaceState has an accessible Home-specific StatePanel presentation; ready renders no redundant status panel.
Previous authoritative product data is preserved only when explicitly present in loading/error/forbidden/offline/recovery states; no synthetic data is invented.

Recovery/error request identifiers flow through StatePanel bidi-safe semantics; urgent error/forbidden states use alert semantics while ordinary loading/empty/recovery/offline states remain polite status announcements.
Retry remains explicit/manual and only appears for bounded retryable Home states; no automatic retry loop, mutation or client business authority is introduced. /search remains a Step-60 handoff only.

Home state/actions/cards use logical RTL CSS, long-text wrapping, minimum 44px interactive targets and responsive/reflow-safe grids across the canonical widths; no brown, row-reverse or physical left/right layout is introduced.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront home-state:verify && Storefront Browser Quality

acceptance_criteria.description: Root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Browser Quality, deterministic review, exact-artifact lock, protected merge and exact-SHA postmerge verification pass before Stage 59-G starts.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 59-F is MEDIUM risk. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited. Stage 59-G remains blocked until protected transport and exact-SHA postmerge verification are green.
